question: Which is the largest Dun formations in India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Dehra Dun. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dehra Dun** is the largest valley in the **Himalayas **and is located in the **state of Uttarakhand.**
 
• It is also known as the **"Doon Valley" **and is surrounded by the **Shivalik Hills on three sides.**
 
• The valley is known for its** scenic beauty** and is a popular tourist destination.
 
• Dehra Dun is also an important education and** research hub** and is home to several prestigious institutions.
